lines.notes: One inclusive constructed-airframe allowance, anchored to $279.99 HAN2345 ARF plus $70.01 planning allowance for historical construction/gear/installation differences. Includes film, fixed tricycle gear, tank, mount, spinner, linkage and hardware; no separate bills for those within this full-build value. Not a quote or HAN2345 package-content claim. Range is a planning assumption; exact Jensen replacement or repair recipes need sourcing.
